# Honeywell Hydraulics

> Industrial hydraulic cylinders, custom hydraulic power packs, and precision CNC-machined manifold blocks manufactured in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. ISO 9001:2015 certified OEM manufacturer serving 25+ heavy industrial sectors and 18 major industrial corridors across India.

Honeywell Hydraulics (est. 2018) is a precision fluid power manufacturer headquartered in Kathwada GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We engineer, manufacture, and test heavy-duty hydraulic equipment for continuous high-cycle operations in plastics, steel, construction, material handling, automotive, and industrial machinery sectors.

- **Primary Domain:** https://honeywellhydraulics.in
- **Headquarters & Factory:** B-18, Suryam Plaza Estate, Near Nilkanth Estate, Road no. 15, Kathwada GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382430, India
- **Coordinates:** 23.035° N, 72.668° E
- **Direct Phone:** +91 99243 43873
- **Sales Inquiries:** sales@honeywellhydraulics.com

- [About Honeywell Hydraulics](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/about-us/): Company profile, ISO 9001:2015 certification, engineering expertise, and industrial fluid power capabilities since 2018.

## Industrial Hydraulic Cylinders

- [Hydraulic Cylinders Overview](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/): Bore 40mm to 500mm, stroke up to 6,000mm, working pressure up to 700 Bar.
- [Custom Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/custom-hydraulic-cylinders/): Tailored bore, stroke, porting, cushioning, and mounting geometries for specialized machinery.
- [Double Acting Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/double-acting-hydraulic-cylinders/): High-cycle powered extension and retraction cylinders for presses, automation, and metal forming (up to 350 Bar).
- [Single Acting Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/single-acting-hydraulic-cylinders/): Gravity and spring return single-stroke hydraulic actuators for tippers, clamps, and fixtures (up to 250 Bar).
- [Telescopic Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/telescopic-hydraulic-cylinders/): 2 to 5 stage multi-stage nested chrome cylinders for high extension in compact retracted lengths.
- [Tie-Rod Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/tie-rod-hydraulic-cylinders/): NFPA standard interchangeable cylinders for injection moulding, machine tooling, and factory automation (up to 160 Bar).
- [Welded Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/welded-hydraulic-cylinders/): Heavy-wall forged construction for construction equipment, earthmoving, mining, and high-vibration applications (up to 350 Bar).
- [Flange Mounted Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/flange-mounted-hydraulic-cylinder/): ISO 6022 front and rear flange mounting for rigid axial hydraulic thrust.
- [Clevis Mounted Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/clevis-mounted-hydraulic-cylinder/): Pivoting clevis pin mounted cylinders for angular articulation and moving linkages.
- [Trunnion Mounted Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/trunnion-mounted-hydraulic-cylinder/): Head, cap, or intermediate trunnion mountings for balanced pivotal load distribution.
- [Square Body Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/square-body-hydraulic-cylinder/): Compact block-style industrial hydraulic cylinders for die-casting, plastic moulds, and machine tools.
- [Goods Lift Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/goods-lift-hydraulic-cylinders/): High-safety dual-seal single and double-acting rams for freight elevators and warehouse lifts.
- [Car Parking Hydraulic Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/car-parking-hydraulic-cylinders/): Direct-acting lifting cylinders for multi-level puzzle parking and stacker systems.
- [Scissor Lift Table Cylinders](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-cylinders/scissor-lift-table-hydraulic-cylinder/): Heavy-thrust compact actuators with built-in velocity fuses for industrial lifting platforms.

## Custom Hydraulic Power Packs

- [Hydraulic Power Packs Overview](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/): Motor 0.5 HP to 75 HP, tank 10L to 2,000L, working pressure up to 450 Bar.
- [Three-Phase Hydraulic Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/three-phase-hydraulic-power-packs/): 415V continuous duty power units with gear/piston pumps for 24/7 manufacturing plants.
- [Single-Phase Hydraulic Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/single-phase-hydraulic-power-packs/): 220V compact hydraulic power units for small workshop machinery, auto garage lifts, and mobile units.
- [High-Low Hydraulic Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/high-low-hydraulic-power-packs/): Dual pump high-flow low-pressure rapid approach with low-flow high-pressure clamping.
- [Hydraulic Power Packs for Hydraulic Presses](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/hydraulic-power-packs-for-press/): High-tonnage fluid power units for 50T to 1,000T deep-drawing, compression, and forging presses.
- [Multi-Station Solenoid Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/multistation-hydraulic-power-packs/): Centralized multi-valve manifold assemblies for synchronized sequencing of multiple hydraulic actuators.
- [Accumulator Hydraulic Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/accumulator-hydraulic-power-packs/): Bladder and piston accumulator storage units for instantaneous peak flow and emergency fail-safe backup.
- [Hand Lever Operated Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/hand-lever-operated-hydraulic-power-packs/): Rugged manual directional valve power units for proportional operator control.
- [Hand Pump Operated Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/hand-pump-operated-hydraulic-power-packs/): Zero-power manual backup pumping stations for field machinery and emergency positioning.
- [Custom Engineered Hydraulic Power Packs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/hydraulic-power-packs/customized-hydraulic-power-packs/): Tailored reservoirs, fluid filtration, air/water heat exchangers, and PLC electric control panels.

## Hydraulic Manifold Blocks

- [Hydraulic Manifold Blocks Overview](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/manifold-blocks/): CETOP 03 / NG6 to CETOP 10 / NG32 precision subplates and multi-station blocks.
- [06-Size Manifold Blocks (CETOP 3 / NG6)](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/manifold-blocks/06-size-manifold-blocks/): Compact subplates and parallel circuits for D03 directional control valves (up to 315 Bar).
- [10-Size Manifold Blocks (CETOP 5 / NG10)](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/manifold-blocks/10-size-manifold-blocks/): High-flow ductile iron/steel manifold blocks for heavy industrial circuits (up to 350 Bar).
- [CETOP Modular Manifold Blocks](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/manifold-blocks/cetop-manifold-blocks/): ISO 4401 compliant sandwich blocks for modular pressure, flow, and check valve stacking.
- [Custom CNC Manifold Blocks](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/manifold-blocks/custom-manifold-blocks/): In-house 4-axis CNC machined complex integrated logic blocks with Sun, HydraForce, and Rexroth cavities.
- [Multi-Station Manifold Blocks](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/products/manifold-blocks/multi-station-manifold-blocks/): 2 to 10 station monolithic blocks eliminating external piping and leak paths.

## Regional Industrial Hubs & Supply Corridors

- [Ahmedabad Industrial Hub](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/ahmedabad/): Kathwada GIDC headquarters, Vatva, Odhav, Naroda, Changodar, and Sanand auto corridor.
- [Surat Industrial Hub](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/surat/): Sachin, Hazira, and Pandesara textile and diamond machinery clusters.
- [Vadodara Industrial Hub](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/vadodara/): Makarpura, Savli, and Waghodia heavy engineering and chemical equipment.
- [Rajkot Industrial Hub](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/rajkot/): Metoda, Aji, and Shapar-Veraval machine tools, foundries, and diesel engine components.
- [Morbi Industrial Hub](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/morbi/): Hydraulic press systems and cylinders for India's ceramic tile manufacturing hub.
- [Vapi & Ankleshwar Chemical Belt](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/vapi/): Chemical processing, paper mills, and pharmaceutical fluid power applications.
- [Bhavnagar & Alang Marine Hub](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/bhavnagar/): Marine hydraulic systems and ultra-heavy ship breaking cutting shear cylinders.
- [Gujarat State Overview](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/gujarat/): Comprehensive state-wide manufacturing and supply chain footprint across 12 industrial districts.
- [Maharashtra Industrial Corridor](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/maharashtra/): Pune (Chakan / Bhosari / Pimpri), Mumbai, Nashik, and Aurangabad automotive OEM supply.
- [Karnataka Industrial Hubs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/karnataka/): Bengaluru (Peenya / Bommasandra), Hubli, and Belagavi aerospace and precision engineering.
- [Tamil Nadu Industrial Hubs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/tamil-nadu/): Chennai (Sriperumbudur / Oragadam), Coimbatore, and Hosur automotive and manufacturing belts.
- [Madhya Pradesh Industrial Hubs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/madhya-pradesh/): Indore, Pithampur auto cluster, Sanwer Road, and Bhopal engineering corridor.
- [Rajasthan Industrial Hubs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/rajasthan/): Bhiwadi, Neemrana Japanese zone, Jaipur, and Udaipur mining equipment.
- [West Bengal Industrial Hubs](https://honeywellhydraulics.in/locations/west-bengal/): Kolkata, Howrah foundry hub, and Durgapur steel corridor.
